reuse.why: Uses the existing db.first access and LinkAccountBaseParams' upgradingId; there was no existing duplicate-link helper to reuse.

duplication.why: The check is written once and invoked by each of the five provider link functions; only the provider literal is repeated, mirroring what each function already writes into account_sync_source.

placement.why: Lives in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers it guards; link.ts could also have hosted it, but the placement is consistent with the tree.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and a release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: One small named guard with a clear query; the remaining weakness is that each new provider must remember to call it because the five link functions stay copy-pasted.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction is bypassed; all link paths call the new guard.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called at the top of every link*Account function.
